import urllib.request,json,hashlib,os,pathlib
base='http://127.0.0.1:17448'
out={}
try:
 with urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/managed-chats',timeout=7) as x: j=json.load(x)
 rows=j.get('chats',[])
 out['total']=len(rows)
 out['curator_matches']=[{'id':r.get('id'),'url':r.get('url'),'profileId':r.get('profileId'),'repo':r.get('repository'),'branch':r.get('branch'),'head':r.get('gitHead')} for r in rows if r.get('id')=='tg-curator-owner' or r.get('url')=='https://chatgpt.com/c/6ac7068e-883c-83ed-9081-cb94557e61bd']
 out['other_chats']=[{'id':r.get('id'),'name':r.get('name'),'profileId':r.get('profileId')} for r in rows if r.get('id')!='tg-curator-owner']
except Exception as e:out['read_error']=type(e).__name__
try:
 p=pathlib.Path(os.getenv('LOCALAPPDATA',''))/'Neur0StoreCurator'
 out['backup_count']=len(list(p.glob('managed-chats-backup-*.json'))) if p.is_dir() else 0
except Exception as e:out['backup_error']=type(e).__name__
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=True))
